tips.text: Walk around the Vital Duelist's Dance shows on the enemy and hit it from that side. It heals you and gives a burst of Move Speed.
Aim Lunge so the Vital is the closest target; it goes for Vitals first. Use the dash to start a trade or to get away.
Use Riposte when the enemy casts a stun or other disable on you. You block it and your stab stuns them instead of slowing them.
Don't waste Riposte on weak hits. Hold it for the enemy's strongest damage, since it blocks all damage for a moment.
Hit with Bladework first to leave them slowed, then finish with the guaranteed critical second attack.
Use Grand Challenge on a durable target or the front line, then hit its Vitals. If you land them, your allies heal in the zone.
Trade in short bursts. Hit a Vital, use the Move Speed to step out, then come back for the next one.

combos.name: Riposte cancel on Lunge
combos.when: When you want to dodge a key enemy spell mid-dash, or turn the Lunge to hit a target behind you.
combos.text: Fiora can cast during the Lunge dash, so you can start Riposte mid-dash. Riposte can also turn her to aim the stab at a target behind her.

combos.name: Riposte to stun
combos.when: When an enemy is about to cast a crowd control spell on you, such as a stun, snare or knock-up.
combos.text: Cast Riposte just before the crowd control lands. It negates the effect and turns the stab into a stun on the enemy champion it hits.

tips.text: Use Riposte when Aatrox's Infernal Chains lands; it blocks the pull and the damage, and the enemy ends up slowed.
Hold Riposte for the sweetspot of The Darkin Blade. If it knocks you up, Riposte turns that into a stun on him.
Aatrox's attacks are slow and easy to see. Lunge in once he has used The Darkin Blade, then trade quickly and get out.
Lunge at the Vital that faces you to get the heal and Move Speed. Use that speed to step out of his Infernal Chains area.
Fight when Aatrox is spent. His Umbral Dash heals him when he hits you, so avoid long trades when he is ready.
Keep Riposte ready for Akali's Shuriken Flip or Perfect Execution; blocking them wastes her trade and leaves her exposed.
Lunge in as soon as she wastes her energy or abilities, and strike the Vital for health and speed.
Do not chase Akali into Twilight Shroud; stay out of the smoke and wait for her to reveal herself.
Aim Riposte at her when she dashes in; it slows or stuns her.
Save Riposte for Lacerate or Public Execution; parrying the slow or the stun turns it into a stun on Ambessa instead.
Use Lunge to hit a Vital, then walk away on the Move Speed you gain. Short trades suit you more than long brawls.
Hold Riposte when Repudiation is braced and about to land. It blocks the slam and the stab hits her back.
Ambessa's abilities cost Energy. When she runs low, step in and trade with Bladework.
Use Riposte when Anivia casts Flash Frost's stun or Crystallize at you. You can negate the stun and stun her back.
Close in with Lunge when Flash Frost is on cooldown. Anivia has little to stop you then.
Don't stand in Glacial Storm once it fully forms; it slows you and hurts. Step around it and go for Anivia.
Anivia returns as an egg after she dies. Kill it before she is reborn, or don't over-commit when she is low.
Watch the Frostbite after a Flash Frost hit; it hits hard. Avoid the ice and you avoid the combo.
Use Riposte on Aurora's Twofold Hex or The Weirding; it blocks the damage and the slow, and your stab slows her in return.
Lunge in when Aurora's Vital faces you; the stab goes for it first, so you heal and speed up.
Hold Riposte for Aurora's Between Worlds shockwave and slows if you are caught; it can stop them.
Do not chase Aurora after Across the Veil; she turns invisible and gets faster. Save Lunge and go back to farming.
Close the gap with Bladework's slow, then trade; Aurora's mana-heavy spells make long poke fights hard for her.
Hold Riposte for Briar's Head Rush; parrying the stun turns it into a stun on her and wastes her best engage.
Riposte her Chilling Scream when it knocks you into a wall, since you can negate the stun and hit back.
Use Lunge on the Vital to heal and gain speed while Briar is forced to run at you in Blood Frenzy.
Save Grand Challenge for when Briar is low, because her healing makes long fights hard to finish.
Hold Riposte for Camille's Hookshot dash. If it catches her stun, the enemy is stunned instead of slowed and you win the trade.
Use Riposte when Camille locks you in with The Hextech Ultimatum. It blocks the effects of her cast, so time it for her leap landing.
Lunge onto Camille's Vital to heal and speed up, then step out of the outer half of Tactical Sweep so you are not slowed.
Camille's shield only blocks one damage type. Trade with Bladework when it is down, since it slows her and the second hit is a guaranteed crit.
Save Lunge for a gap Camille makes with Hookshot, so you can chase her down after she dives.
Use Riposte when Cho'Gath casts Rupture; you dodge the damage and stun him if you parry the knock up.
Watch for the smoke from Rupture and step out of it. Lunge through the area only once it has landed.
Stay out of close range of Feral Scream when your Riposte is down; being silenced leaves you with no escape or parry.
Trade when his Vorpal Spikes are on cooldown, and hit his Vitals to heal and speed up.
Use Grand Challenge on him early in a fight; he is a big target, but Feast lets him heal back with Carnivore.
Hold Riposte for Apprehend. If you parry the pull, Darius is stunned instead of slowed, and you win the trade.
Use Lunge to hit a Vital and slip out of Decimate range. The Move Speed it gives helps you get away.
Trade while Apprehend is on cooldown. Darius has a hard time catching you then.
Fight him in short trades. A long brawl lets Hemorrhage stack up and makes him much stronger.
Use Bladework to slow him when you walk in, so he has a harder time hitting you with Decimate.
Hold Riposte for Dr. Mundo's Infected Bonesaw; parrying it stops the damage and the slow.
Dodge the Infected Bonesaw by stepping aside, since it only hits the first enemy in its line. Don't walk straight at him.
Dr. Mundo resists the first immobilizing effect he takes, so don't count on a Riposte stun; use it to block his damage.
Hit the Vital with Lunge to heal and speed away. Trade in short bursts, because he out-heals long fights.
Hit him with Riposte when his Heart Zapper is about to recast, so the blocked damage isn't stored and healed back.
Use Riposte when Gangplank goes for a keg or Parrrley. It blocks the damage and slows him.
Lunge in when he has few kegs in stock, then trade with Bladework before he can set up.
Stay out of keg blast zones. The explosions slow you and hit hard.
Don't rely on stunning him with Riposte when Remove Scurvy is ready. He can cleanse it.
Once Gangplank hits level 6, stay near allies or out of the open. Cannon Barrage can hit you from anywhere on the map.
Hold Riposte for Garen's Decisive Strike. Parrying the silenced hit wastes his big damage and leaves you ready to fight back.
Garen can't attack while spinning Judgment. Hit your Vitals and step out of the circle.
Trade in short bursts and then back off. Perseverance heals Garen when he isn't hit for a while, so keep hitting him.
Keep your health high. Garen's Demacian Justice finishes low-health targets, so back off when you're hurt.
Lunge onto Garen when his Decisive Strike is spent. Bladework's slow then helps you get away.
Hold Riposte for Gnar's Wallop or his GNAR! throw; it cancels the stun and he gets stunned instead.
Mini Gnar outranges you, so close the gap with Lunge and trade when his Hop is on cooldown.
Fight Gnar right after he shrinks from Mega form; he can't build Rage for a while then.
Hit him with Bladework's first attack to slow him, then keep fighting; the second attack always crits.
Stay away from walls when Gnar is big, since GNAR! stuns anyone knocked into one.
Hold Riposte when Gragas goes for Body Slam; parrying it stuns him instead of slowing him.
Gragas's Barrel Roll is slow and easy to see; step out of it or Lunge away before it blows up.
Trade when Drunken Rage is on cooldown; with it up, Gragas takes less damage and his next hit hurts.
Don't chase Gragas far; Body Slam comes back quickly, so he can escape or hit you.
Stay away from walls and your own tower when Gragas has Explosive Cask, since it knocks you away from him.
Hold Riposte for Gwen's Needlework slow or any crowd control she throws at you; parrying it turns the enemy stunned.
Don't chase into Hallowed Mist; Gwen can't be targeted from outside it. Wait for it to end, then go in.
Use Lunge on the Vital to close the gap, then trade with Bladework so the first hit slows her.
Trade early, before Gwen has built up Snip Snip! stacks.
Use Grand Challenge when you commit to a kill; Gwen can't easily outrun the speed boost from the Vitals.
Hold Riposte for Heimerdinger's grenade. Parrying its stun makes your stab stun him instead.
Use Lunge to jump on Heimerdinger once his grenade is on cooldown. Then hit his Vital for speed and healing.
Take out his turrets with the help of minions rather than one at a time, so they can't support each other.
Dodge Hextech Micro-Rockets by stepping out of their line. Parry them with Riposte if you can't.
Go in when his ultimate is on cooldown; he has far fewer ways out of trouble then.

comboRefs.note: Riposte negates Heimerdinger's grenade stun and turns the stab into a stun on him.
Riposte mid-Lunge lets Fiora dodge a grenade thrown at her while dashing in.

tips.text: Hold Riposte for Test of Spirit; if you parry the tendril, the spirit is not pulled out of the target and the enemy is stunned instead.
Fight away from Illaoi's Tentacles. Tentacles only hit when she commands them, but they add a lot of damage and healing to her trades.
Use Lunge to reach Illaoi when a Vital is facing you, then step back out with the movement speed.
Dodge Tentacle Smash by moving sideways, or parry it with Riposte; it has a slow wind-up.
Trade with Bladework when she leaps in with Harsh Lesson; the slow lets you leave before the Tentacles finish.
Keep Riposte for Irelia's Flawless Duet or Vanguard's Edge cage. Parrying her stun turns it into a stun on her.
Don't spend your big spells on Defiant Dance. It can't be interrupted and cuts the damage she takes.
Fight her away from the minion wave. Without minions, Bladesurge has little to dash to.
Hit a Vital with Lunge to heal and gain speed, then trade. Fight her when Ionian Fervor stacks are low.
Use Riposte to block Jax's Counter Strike stun or his Leap Strike; hitting him afterward leaves him stunned instead of slowed.
Don't attack into Counter Strike. Wait it out, then strike after his dodge ends, or use Lunge to hit a Vital and still stay out of his stun.
Trade quickly and back out. Break Jax's chain of attacks so Relentless Assault never builds up.
Hit Vitals with Duelist's Dance for the speed boost, and use it to slip away from Jax once he gets his Grandmaster-at-Arms bonus.
Use Bladework to slow Jax on your first attack when he dives in, then finish with the critical strike.
Hold Riposte for Thundering Blow. It stops the root and knockback, and Jayce is stunned instead of slowed.
Time Riposte for the moment Jayce leaps in with To the Skies!, so he lands next to you and takes the stab.
Use Lunge to close the gap when Jayce is in Cannon Stance, and hit the Vital to heal and speed up.
Don't stand in a line with Jayce at range. Riposte can parry a Shock Blast, so save it for that.
Trade with Bladework and Lunge when Jayce is in Hammer Stance, then back off before his cooldowns return.
Save Grand Challenge for a committed fight. Jayce is easy to burst once his abilities are used.

comboRefs.note: Riposte can negate Jayce's Thundering Blow knockback and turn the parry into a stun on him.

tips.text: Hold Riposte for K'Sante's stun from Ntofo Strikes or his ultimate; parrying it turns the stab into a stun on him.
Parry Path Maker as he finishes charging; Riposte negates the stun and he is stunned instead.
Once he goes All Out, he is much squishier. Use Grand Challenge and fight him then.
Lunge in to hit a Vital, then step out. Don't linger in his range after his Ntofo Strikes slows you.
Press your advantage before Kayle reaches level 6. She is a weak melee champion until then, so trade and push her back.
Use Lunge to close in on Kayle, aiming at a Vital when you can. Kayle becomes dangerous once she has range.
Use Riposte when Kayle fires Radiant Blast at you. It blocks the projectile, and you get a stab back.
Look for the all-in with Grand Challenge when Kayle is on her own. She is fragile, so killing her fast works well.
Do not chase Kayle during Divine Judgment. She or her ally cannot be damaged, so wait for it to end.
Hold Riposte for Kennen's stun. If you block his stun with it, he gets stunned instead.
Lunge in when Kennen has used Lightning Rush. He is flimsy, so punish him quickly.
Step out of range of Thundering Shuriken, then close the gap with Lunge so Kennen can't poke you freely.
Back off from Slicing Maelstrom at level 6. Fight him after it ends.
Hold Riposte for Bear Trap on a Rope. Parrying the hook turns your stab into a stun and wastes his best tool in lane.
Use Lunge on the Vital to close the gap and escape his pull, then trade quickly and step away.
Once Kled is off his mount he is much weaker, so push the fight. Look for a kill with Grand Challenge before he rebuilds courage and remounts.
Riposte can be used when Kled's Violent Tendencies attacks are about to land. It blocks that damage and slows him.
Keep Riposte for Malphite's Unstoppable Force; parrying the knock up turns it into a stun on him.
Trade in short bursts, since Malphite's Granite Shield recharges when he is left alone. Hit him again before it refreshes.
Do not rely on long auto-attack fights; Ground Slam cuts your Attack Speed. Use Lunge and Vitals for quick trades, then step away.
Seismic Shard slows you and speeds him up, so do not try to run from him once it lands. Fight back or Riposte instead.
Use Riposte when Mordekaiser casts Realm of Death. His ultimate fails and goes on cooldown.
Parry Death's Grasp with Riposte. His pull fails and the enemy champion gets stunned if you parry an immobilizing effect.
Hit the Vital with Lunge, then back away. Keep out of the Darkness Rise aura, which hurts anyone standing close to him.
Trade in short bursts, because Indestructible turns his damage into a shield. Hit and leave before he can recast it for healing.
Hold Riposte for Hounds' Pursuit; if Naafiri's dash slows her, you only parry the hit and the stab follows.
Time Riposte to Naafiri's Darkin Daggers or Eviscerate burst to take no damage and slow her with the stab.
Lunge at the Vital on Naafiri; Lunge goes for a Vital first, so you hit her and not a Packmate.
Fight when her Packmates are gone or away; Eviscerate and The Call of the Pack send them out of the fight for a moment.
Hold Riposte for Wither or any stun or root. Parrying it blunts Nasus's best tool, and a parried disable stuns him.
Use Lunge to hit the Vital on Nasus, then back out. It heals you and gives Move Speed.
Trade early and often, before Siphoning Strike has made Nasus hit hard. Pressure his farm so he cannot stack.
Use Bladework to slow Nasus on your first attack, then finish the trade with the critical strike.
Do not stand in Fury of the Sands to fight him. Wait for it to end, or kite out of range.

comboRefs.note: Nasus's listed abilities include no stun, snare or knock-up, so Riposte has little to negate.

tips.text: Use Riposte on Olaf's Undertow or his chase to dodge it. A parried slow turns into a stun.
Step out of the line of Undertow's axe; being hit slows you and cuts your Armor.
Trade early and back off before he is low; Olaf grows much stronger the lower his Health gets.
Hold Riposte and your disables until Ragnarok ends; during it he can't be disabled.
Stay off Ornn's Volcanic Rupture line, or hold Riposte for it; Riposte blocks the damage and slow, and the fissure's pillar can block your path.
Save Riposte for Searing Charge. If you parry the knock up, Ornn is stunned instead of slowed.
Fight away from walls. Without terrain behind you, Searing Charge can't knock you up.
Use Lunge to close the gap and hit the Vital. The heal and speed let you trade and leave before Ornn answers.
Bellows Breath makes Ornn unstoppable as he marches. Don't try to stun or slow him mid-march; Riposte can still parry the flames.
Use Grand Challenge when Ornn has used his crowd control. It reveals all four Vitals so you can finish him fast.

comboRefs.note: Riposte can negate Ornn's knock-up or slow and turn the stab into a stun on him.

tips.text: Save Riposte for Pantheon's Shield Vault; parrying it stuns him instead of just slowing him.
Do not attack into Aegis Assault from the front; Lunge around to his side or back, or wait it out.
Stay healthy against Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear hits hard once you are low.
Hit the Vitals when Pantheon is busy; the speed boost helps you dodge Comet Spear and close in.
Save Riposte for Vault. If Quinn dashes in and you parry it, she is stunned instead of slowed.
Quinn is a ranged champion, so close the gap with Lunge. Aim it at a Vital so you also heal and speed up.
Sidestep Blinding Assault or use Riposte on it. The parry blocks the damage and the vision loss.
Use Grand Challenge in a short trade when Quinn is cornered, since her Vault escape is on a long cooldown.
Hold Riposte for Renekton's Ruthless Predator or Slice and Dice. Parrying the stun turns it into a stun on him.
Back off when Renekton's Fury is high; his empowered abilities stun longer and hit harder. Trade while his Fury is low.
Avoid fighting him in the middle of minions; Cull the Meek heals him far more there.
Use Lunge on a Vital, then leave once the Move Speed boost kicks in, rather than staying in range of his burst.
Hold Riposte for Riven's Ki Burst or Broken Wings third cast; parrying the stun or knock up lets you stun her back.
Riven's dashes are short, so Lunge onto a Vital to chase her down and punish her when she backs off.
Use Bladework before she dashes in; the slow makes her combo harder to land.
Respect Riven once she uses Blade of the Exile; her range grows and Wind Slash finishes you if you are low.
Bait Rumble's Electro Harpoon with Riposte. If it hits you mid-stance it is blocked, and your stab slows him.
Time Riposte for when Rumble starts Flamespitter. It blocks the flames and punishes him for casting.
Go in with Lunge when Rumble overheats. He cannot cast spells then, so trade freely.
Do not stand in The Equalizer's fire. Walk around the trail or wait it out before you fight.
Rumble's damage is magic, and Riposte cannot block it all. Hit the Vitals with Duelist's Dance for healing and Move Speed so you can close in on him.
Hold Riposte for Facebreaker. If you parry it, the enemy is stunned instead of slowed, and you take no damage from it.
Riposte also answers The Show Stopper's suppress. Time it on his cast and you cancel the grab, but only if you read it correctly.
Parry Haymaker's big punch with Riposte. It wastes his long cooldown and you hit back.
Trade while Haymaker is on cooldown. He has no shield or big punch to answer you then.
Lunge onto the Vital and step back out. The move speed lets you leave before he can land Facebreaker.
Do not fight a low-health Sett for long. Pit Grit heals him more the lower he is, so finish him fast or leave.
Hold Riposte for Shen's Shadow Dash. Parrying the taunt turns it into a stun on him.
Don't fight inside Spirit's Refuge; it blocks your attacks. Wait for it to end or hit Shen when it's down.
Look for the Vital and use Lunge to strike it, gaining speed to get away or press Shen.
Stay out of Twilight Assault's range when you can. A hit slows you and powers up Shen's next attacks.
Watch for Shen vanishing at level 6 with Stand United. He may teleport to a fight; don't chase him far.
Stay out of Poison Trail and do not chase Singed through it; he is hard to kill and the poison adds up.
Hold Riposte for his Fling or Mega Adhesive. Parrying the root or slow means you stab him and he is stunned.
Do not walk into the sticky puddle from Mega Adhesive. Lunge around it instead, because it slows you and keeps you on the ground.
Hit his Vital with Lunge to trade quickly, then run off with the Move Speed before his poison builds up.
Use Grand Challenge to kill him once he has used Fling and Mega Adhesive; he runs away and his speed makes him hard to catch.
Save Riposte for Sion's Decimating Smash. Parrying the stun turns it against him and wastes his best tool.
Stay out of Roar of the Slayer's line while Sion charges. Getting slowed by it is how he sets up the big hit.
Use Lunge on a Vital to trade quickly. Then back off before Sion's shield is ready to blast you.
Parry Unstoppable Onslaught with Riposte when it reaches you. Sion's stun then fails and you get the stun on him.
Save Riposte for Abyssal Dive or Devour; if it blocks his knock up or stun, he gets stunned instead of slowed. Don't waste it on his Tongue Lash.
Tongue Lash stops at the first enemy it hits, so keep a minion between you and him when you stand in range.
Hit him with Lunge when his Vital is facing you, then back off. It restores your health and speeds you up.
Don't fight him at three stacks of An Acquired Taste. Another Tongue Lash then stuns you, and Devour can follow.
Use Grand Challenge when he has taken a lot of damage. His Thick Skin shield and healing blunt long fights, so finish the kill quickly.
When he channels Abyssal Dive, step out of the landing circle or Riposte just as he lands.
Save Riposte for Blinding Dart; parrying it wastes his key spell and blocks the blind.
Use Lunge to close the gap fast, since Teemo outranges you; hit the Vital for speed and healing.
Watch for mushrooms in bushes and on your path before chasing; stepping on Noxious Trap slows you and reveals you.
Use Bladework to slow him as you close in, then finish the trade before his poison adds up.
Hold Riposte for Tryndamere's Spinning Slash or his slows. Parrying a root or stun turns it into a stun on him.
Don't all-in while Undying Rage is ready. He can't be killed for a few seconds, so trade out and wait for it to be used.
Harass him early with Lunge so he can't last-hit freely and heal with Bloodlust.
Hit his Vital with Lunge to heal and gain speed. Use that speed to trade and step out before he can respond.
Don't run from him in a straight line. Mocking Shout slows you when you face away from him.
Wait for Urgot to cast Disdain or Corrosive Charge, then use Riposte. You turn his stun into one on him.
Lunge in when Urgot's legs are on cooldown. His shotguns only fire in the direction they face.
Close the distance with Lunge when Urgot has used Disdain. Trade quickly while it recharges.
Don't stand and fight while he fires Purge; he deals and absorbs a lot of damage. Hit a Vital, then step out.
Use Riposte when you see Varus start Chain of Corruption. The root turns into a stun on him.
Close the gap with Lunge as soon as Varus starts charging Piercing Arrow, because he moves slowly while charging.
Step out of Hail of Arrows' marked ground; it slows you. Lunge across it rather than walking through.
Once you reach Varus, hit his Vitals and stay on him. He has little to stop you up close.
Keep Riposte ready for Vayne's Condemn; it blocks the knockback and she can't pin you to a wall.
Stay away from walls when Riposte is on cooldown; Condemn would stun you into them.
Close the gap with Lunge when Vayne has used Tumble, then trade fast. She is fragile.
Break off after a few hits so Vayne's third Silver Bolts hit doesn't land; fight in short trades.
Bait Sanguine Pool early in a fight, then trade when it ends; he cannot attack or cast while pooled.
Save Riposte for his Hemoplague or a Tides of Blood slow; it blocks them, and a stun only works if he uses a disable.
Lunge onto Vladimir when the Vital is facing you, so you hit it for extra damage and gain speed to get out.
Stay out of Transfusion range early; it hurts and heals him. Fight when it is on cooldown.
Use Grand Challenge on Vladimir and kill him before Hemoplague bursts, or he heals back.

comboRefs.note: Riposte can negate a crowd control effect from Vladimir and stun him, but his listed abilities show no stun or snare.

tips.text: Hold Riposte for when Volibear runs at you with Thundering Smash. Parrying his stun turns it into a stun on him.
Keep Lunge ready to close the gap, and use it on a Vital when Volibear is low on Frenzied Maul bites.
Trade in short bursts and leave. Volibear heals from a second Frenzied Maul on the same target in a long fight.
Step out of the Sky Splitter area when it lands. It slows you and hits for a share of your max health.
Keep Riposte ready for Xin Zhao's Audacious Charge or the third Three Talon Strike. Parrying a knock up gets you a stun.
Back off when Xin Zhao starts Three Talon Strike. If he can't finish the three attacks, his damage and cooldown refunds drop a lot.
Use Lunge to stab Xin Zhao's Vital and disengage, since the speed boost helps you run. Lunge also cuts its own cooldown when it hits.
Keep your allies spread out before Crescent Guard. If you are caught inside it you will be stunned, and it hurts a lot.
Use Riposte on Yasuo's whirlwind from Steel Tempest; it blocks the knock up and stabs him back with a slow.
Hold Riposte for Yasuo's knock up and you turn his crowd control into a stun on him.
Yasuo's Wind Wall blocks projectiles, but Lunge is a dash and stab, so use it to close in and hit a Vital while the wall is up.
Use Lunge to chase Yasuo after he dashes away; it prioritizes a champion whose Vital faces you.
Use Grand Challenge when you can fight him for a while; it reveals every Vital and heals your team if you succeed.
Hit Yasuo with Bladework first to slow him, then use Lunge to stick to him.
Hold Riposte for Yone's Mortal Steel at two stacks or Fate Sealed; parrying the knock up or stun turns your stab into a stun.
Use Lunge on the Vital he is showing you, then follow with Bladework to slow him and get a quick trade.
Do not walk into Spirit Cleave carelessly; it hurts more against high Health and gives him a shield.
When he uses Soul Unbound, back off and let it run out, or trade carefully; he repeats part of the damage he dealt when it ends.
Grand Challenge on Yone shows all four Vitals; hit them and run the fight, since he cannot easily outrun your Move Speed.
Keep Riposte for Yorick's Mourning Mist or any stun or root; parrying one turns your stab into a stun.
Kill his Mist Walkers with a quick attack before you fight Yorick; they die to one basic attack.
Hit the Vital with Lunge to heal and speed up, then step away from his Last Rites and its healing.
Attack Dark Procession to break it, or walk around it, before you chase him.
Use Grand Challenge on Yorick when his Maiden of the Mist is gone, so you can finish him.
Hold Riposte for Dreaded Return. Parrying the pull stuns Zaahen instead of slowing him, and it blocks the damage too.
Time Riposte for the knock up from The Darkin Glaive. Parrying it turns your stab into a stun.
Zaahen cannot be stopped during Grim Deliverance. Wait out the slam, then trade back when he lands.
Use Lunge to hit the Vital as you close in, then back off with the Move Speed. Trade in short bursts so Zaahen cannot build his stacks.
Do not fight Zaahen when his stacks are full. He hits much harder and can come back from a kill, so let the stacks fade first.
